title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). 18th century, Late Safavid or Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1922. inv. no 174 (3944) from Cerablus (Kargamish, Gaziantep, Turkey). 257 x 642 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 56.
